ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A narrative is (1 mark)
   A. a form
   B. a list of names
   C. a story that tells what happened
   D. a map

2. Which word starts with the cluster 'sn'? (1 mark)
   A. treatment
   B. stitch
   C. snake
   D. stop

3. What does 'customer' mean? (1 mark)
   A. A teacher
   B. A person who buys something or uses a service
   C. A person who sells goods
   D. A doctor

4. What is the past participle of 'eat'? (1 mark)
   A. eating
   B. eated
   C. ate
   D. eaten

5. What is the plural of 'leaf'? (1 mark)
   A. leafs
   B. leafes
   C. leaf
   D. leaves

6. 'She reads a lot.' Here 'a lot' means (1 mark)
   A. a place
   B. never
   C. only one book
   D. often or much

7. In the safety dialogue, why did the message say 'You have won a prize'? (1 mark)
   A. To reward Neema
   B. It was a trick to steal information
   C. To help her homework
   D. To teach spelling

8. Which sentence is in the past tense? (1 mark)
   A. Baraka is clicking Send.
   B. Baraka will click Send.
   C. Baraka clicks Send.
   D. Baraka clicked Send.

9. Which is the correct spelling of the word used to give a reason? (1 mark)
   A. becase
   B. because
   C. becuase
   D. becouse

10. To compose an email means to (1 mark)
   A. print a message
   B. write a new message
   C. delete a message
   D. answer a phone

11. Which word is an adverb of manner? (1 mark)
   A. tomorrow
   B. never
   C. carefully
   D. outside

12. Which conjunction shows a difference? 'The water looked clean, ____ it was not safe.' (1 mark)
   A. or
   B. but
   C. so
   D. and

13. Complete: 'Give the book to ___.' (Ann and Eve) (1 mark)
   A. them
   B. their
   C. they
   D. theirs

14. Which word needs a capital letter? (1 mark)
   A. week
   B. season
   C. morning
   D. Friday

15. Which word completes 'The coach is asking, "____ scored the goal?"'? (1 mark)
   A. When
   B. Who
   C. Where
   D. Whose

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Rewrite with correct capital letters and full stops: 'we visited lake victoria in august' (3 marks)

17. Rewrite in the past tense: 'Today we sweep the compound and plant a tree.' (2 marks)

18. Give one direct question and one indirect question about a story of a birthday party. (3 marks)

19. Rewrite in the plural: 'The child put a loaf and a tomato in the box.' (3 marks)

20. Give two things you can add to a pictorial composition that are not in the pictures. (2 marks)

21. Why is it important to interpret road signs correctly? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — a story that tells what happened
   It tells events in order.

2. C — snake
   Snake starts with s and n.

3. B — A person who buys something or uses a service
   A customer visits a shop or a barber.

4. D — eaten
   Eat, ate, eaten.

5. D — leaves
   Change f to ves.

6. D — often or much
   A lot at the end of a sentence tells how much or how often.

7. B — It was a trick to steal information
   The message asked for her name and address.

8. D — Baraka clicked Send.
   Clicked is the past form.

9. B — because
   Because is spelt b-e-c-a-u-s-e.

10. B — write a new message
   Compose means to write.

11. C — carefully
   'Carefully' tells how something is done.

12. B — but
   'But' shows contrast.

13. A — them
   Them is the object form of they.

14. D — Friday
   Days of the week begin with capital letters.

15. B — Who
   'Who' asks about a person.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: We visited Lake Victoria in August.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for We, 1 mark for Lake Victoria and August, 1 mark for the full stop.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Today we swept the compound and planted a tree.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for swept and 1 for planted.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Direct: What time did the guests arrive? Indirect: Why do you think the girl was excited?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each question and 1 mark for correct types.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: The children put loaves and tomatoes in the boxes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for children, loaves and tomatoes and boxes (award 3 for all correct).

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: What people say, and how people feel or think.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Signs warn us of danger and tell us what to do, so misunderstanding one could cause an accident.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for what signs do and 1 mark for the danger of misunderstanding.
